Name: Werefish Willy
Author: Zldritch
Description:
Cosmetic mod for Willy, modifies Willy's sprite sheets under the conditions of rain, green rain, snow or storm. Also adds Sebastian dialogue about Willy, and alters some of Willy's lines when it rains, storms, green rains, or snows.

1.0.4 Patch Notes:
- Added update functionality
- Added fish noises to some of Willy's dialogue when in fish form
- Added Rain-exclusive Sebastian Dialogue about Willy (changes depending on whether player is married to Seb)
- Willy should no longer be a fish during the desert festival, even if it is raining in Pelican Town

Note: Willy's dialogue changes and Sebastian's post-marriage dialogue change may not be compatible with other dialogue-altering or dialogue-adding content patches or mods!
